client.client_name: Cascade Residential Services LLC (d/b/a Cascade Services)
client.business_model: Multi-brand residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services platform that acquires and supports independent home-service contractors across the Southeastern U.S.
client.client_history: Cascade Residential Services LLC was formed in December 2022 through a partnership between Trive Capital (Dallas) and LP First Capital (Austin) to build a leading residential tri-trade platform. The company has since acquired several Florida-based HVAC and electrical contractors, opened its headquarters in Tampa in February 2024, and continues to pursue add-on acquisitions across the South Atlantic and Gulf States.
